correctness.rationale: The hub-and-triangle automorphism action gives exactly three types of leader pairs. A trace formula follows from independent 2x2 peripheral blocks when grounding the hub. In the other two orbits, the central hub Schur complements equal 2 and 4-2/(1+t), respectively. The exact comparisons B-C=t(2mt+2m+5t+3)/(2(1+t)(1+2t))>0 and C-A=((2m-7)t+2m-3)/(2(1+2t)) give sharp t=1/3 for m=2, t=3 for m=3, and strictly optimal hub-plus-peripheral when m>=4. Independently checked 610 grounded inverse matrices at rational weights by separate exact Gauss-Jordan elimination; no numerical simulation substitutes for the algebra.
